### UTC Date & Time

[October 15, 2025, 16:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/oct-15-2025/4pm)

### Agenda

## Call for Input
- Discussion on new [EIP editor – Mercy](https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/391)
- [Allow links to Protocol Buffers specification](https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/389)

## Editors’ Discussion
-  Linking a discussion to section for reference implementation Ref: [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/916516304972824576/916713912970412103/1426292087036580054)
- EIP-1 Updates & Editorial Policies
Discuss and decide on possible additions to EIP-1 regarding EIPs/ERCs, including:
  - Policy on accepting typo-only PRs
  - Policy on edits to Final EIPs allowing EIP editors to merge PRs after 4 weeks with consensus when the author is absent/unavailable
- Any other Process Change Recommendations (Community Feedback, if any)
- PRs for Editors review and/or consensus 
- Misc
  - [Website: Add dark mode toggle to nav EIPs#10154](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10154) [Keep or Close]
- Force merge
  - [Update EIP-1014: Complete address formula rationale explanation EIPs#10074](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10074)
  - [Update EIP-969: fix broken discussion link EIPs#10513](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10513)
  - [CI: Generate ordered lists of pull requests needing review EIPs#8831](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8831)
- Typo
  - [Update EIP-2025: fix typo in EIPS/eip-2025.md EIPs#10326](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10326)
  - [Update EIP-712: typo, reference ERC spec correctly and formats EIPs#9872](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9872) [Author not around/responding]
  - [Update ERC-601: fix a typo ERCs#1150](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1150)
  - [Update ERC-7092: Fix typos in ERC-7092 documentation ERCs#1190](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1190)
  - [Update ERC-7573: Fix typo ERCs#1202](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1202)
  - [Update ERC-5773: Fix typo ERCs#1205](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1205)

## PR analytics & Editors’ Updates
- Observations from incoming PRs over the past month
- Availability for hosting EIP Editing Office Hours -> add to the [schedule](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1L1_HMqXyYndQZzG3494wcqFcUv9RpzzX67Rdo0UnKqU/edit?gid=0#gid=0)

## EIP Insight
- [October 2025](https://eipsinsight.com/insight/2025/10)

## Community update 
- Project Showcase or feedback
  -  more feedback for dip.box

## Next meeting - 12 or 19 or 26 November (Nov 19 is the week of Devconnect)?

## EIPsInsight Team would like to demo

1. **FUSAKA Network Upgrade Countdown**
   Live countdown to Ethereum’s next major upgrade (Mainnet date: TBD).
2. **EIP Boards Extension**
   We’re **planning** to expand the EIP Boards page with richer proposal tracking, status insights, and contributor mapping.
3. **Transaction Tracker**
   We’re **planning** to build a tool to monitor and analyze **on-chain transactions**.
4. **Contributors Analytics Page**
   We’re **planning** a dashboard to track contributor activity across repos.

We are hoping to have feedback for our initiative to create cross-industry collaboration workspace for EIP development https://dip.box , particularly possible features: 

- EIP editing & github forks abstractions to
- State machine streamlining for EIPs
- Can indexing gas spent by protocol users, and allowing do indicative support to EIPs possibly can prioritizing EIPs to review? 
- any possible feature requests?
